subject: Request: Support roster, escalation paths & PO workflow for vendor onboarding
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@nimbusdata.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Support roster, escalation paths & PO workflow for vendor onboarding

Hi Alex —

Welcome, and thanks for partnering with Redwood. Procurement is starting the vendor setup for Nimbus so we can get PO generation, billing, and support onboarding completed before the pilot starts. To keep the kickoff efficient, can you send the following by end-of-day Monday (Nov 9)?

1) Support roster (CSV or spreadsheet): names, roles (Tier 1/2/3), primary email, escalation phone (if different), timezone
2) Escalation paths (clear chain for P1/P2 incidents) including 24/7 emergency contact and an exec escalation contact
3) SLA summary: uptime commitment, scheduled maintenance windows, notification cadence for incidents, RTO/RPO where applicable, and P1/P2/P3 response & resolution targets
4) PO & invoicing workflow: legal entity for billing, billing contact/email, invoicing email, accepted invoice fields (PO number?), standard payment terms (Net 30/Net 45), where to send W-9 or tax docs
5) Any onboarding forms you expect us to complete (security questionnaire, access forms, SSO metadata) and the preferred channel to share them (Drive link, secure upload, or vendor portal)

If you already have template docs (SLA overview, roster CSV, W-9) please attach. We'll schedule a 30-minute kickoff next week once we have the roster and PO details.

Thanks —
Rishi Malhotra
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@nimbusdata.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@nimbusdata.com, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 11:28:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Support roster, escalation paths & PO workflow for vendor onboarding

Hi Rishi —

Thanks for the note. See answers below (high level) and attached files: Nimbus_SLA_Overview.pdf and SLA_Roster_v1.csv. We can provide a SOC 2 report and full security package once the NDA/contract is signed (DocuSign link to follow).

Support roster: attached CSV includes Tier classifications and primary on-call emails. Tier 1 is our front-line support (email response), Tier 2 is engineering triage, Tier 3 is senior engineering and on-call rotation.

Escalation/incident path:
- P1 (production down): 1-hour acknowledged; 4-hour initial mitigation; dedicated war room if >4 hours
- P2 (degraded): 4-hour acknowledged; 24-hour resolution target
- P3 (minor): 1 business day acknowledgement; 5 business day fix target
Emergency contact: +1 (415) 555-0134 (on-call rotation)
Exec escalation: Sarah Kim, Head of Customer Success — sarah.kim@nimbusdata.com

SLA / uptime: 99.95% monthly uptime target. Maintenance windows: pref. Sundays 02:00–04:00 PT with 72-hour scheduled notice for non-emergency maintenance. Incident notifications via email + PagerDuty (we can add Redwood distribution list).

PO & invoicing: Billing entity: Nimbus Data Systems, Inc.; invoices to be sent to billing@nimbusdata.com for processing, or to accounts-payable@redwood.com if you prefer Redwood's AP intake (see your internal guidance). Net 30 common; we can accept PO numbers on invoice. We will attach Nimbus_W9.pdf after contract finalize.

Attachments: Nimbus_SLA_Overview.pdf, SLA_Roster_v1.csv

Let me know if you want a short call tomorrow or early next week to walk through details. We'll also push the DocuSign contract to you today.

Best,
Alex Rivera
Head of Partnerships
Nimbus Data Systems

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@nimbusdata.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 05 Nov 2026 12:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Support roster, escalation paths & PO workflow for vendor onboarding

Alex — thanks for the quick turnaround and the attachments. A couple of quick procurement questions so we can map internal routing: 

- Which email should we use to send the PO once it's issued? (Rishi, will you confirm internal AP address — typically accounts-payable@redwoodinference.com)
- Please confirm legal billing name exactly as it should appear on invoice (we need this for the PO and for tax).
- Are you able to accept invoices that reference an external marketplace order ID if the purchase goes through a cloud marketplace?
- For the exec escalation contact (Sarah Kim) — can you provide a direct phone and timezone?

We'll aim to get the PO in your system within 5 business days after contract signature, assuming W-9 and billing details are in place. If there are any required vendor onboarding forms that only Nimbus can initiate, point us to them and we'll complete anything on our side promptly.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

On Thu, Nov 5, 2026 at 11:28 AM Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@nimbusdata.com> wrote:

Marissa / Rishi —

Confirming the billing/legal details you asked for:
- Legal billing name: Nimbus Data Systems, Inc.
- Billing contact (receives invoices): billing@nimbusdata.com
- AP acceptance: We can accept invoices via billing@nimbusdata.com or via the Redwood AP inbox (accounts-payable@redwoodinference.com). Please include PO number on invoice.
- Marketplaces: yes, we can map external marketplace order IDs to invoices — let us know the marketplace ID early so we can correlate.
- Exec escalation contact: Sarah Kim — +1 (415) 555-0188 (PST)

Attached: Nimbus_W9.pdf (for your AP), updated SLA roster CSV. DocuSign: https://docusign.com/some-doc-id-7890 (contract submitted for signature).

Proposed kickoff: Tue, Nov 10 2026 @ 10:00 AM PT — 30 minutes to review support routing and incident playbooks. If that works, I’ll add a calendar invite and include PagerDuty integration steps.

Thanks,
Alex

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@nimbusdata.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 14:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Support roster, escalation paths & PO workflow for vendor onboarding

Alex —

Appreciate the fast responses and the attachments. Confirming:
- We received Nimbus_W9.pdf and SLA_Roster_v1.csv.
- Net 30 is acceptable; we will instruct AP to include your billing email and PO number on invoices.
- Kickoff Tue, Nov 10 @ 10:00 AM PT works for the team. Please include the on-call contact and PagerDuty integration steps in the calendar invite.

Next steps for procurement: I’ll open the vendor record and create the PO once the DocuSign contract is fully executed and your W-9 is in our system. If anything changes on your side, please update the shared Proc folder (link: https://docs.redwood.com/PROC/Nimbus-DN-45890).

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

Rishi Malhotra
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
